title: Emission Characterizes a Computed Bit
statement: Let $M$ be a finite binary Turing machine, let $x$ be a binary word, let $b$ be a bit, and let $t$ be a natural number. If $M$ halts within $t$ steps on input $x$ with output consisting of the single bit $b$, then the Boolean decision of whether some time $s<t$ has a snapshot whose selected transition emits $1$ is equal to $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$M$ computes the one-bit output $[b]$ on $x$ within $t$ steps
